title: service.update
description: Update existing services. The serviceid property must be defined for each service, all other properties are optional; only the passed properties are updated.

serviceid.description: ID of the service to update.

algorithm.description: Status calculation rule. Only applicable if child services exist. Possible values: 0 - set status to OK; 1 - most critical if all children have problems; 2 - most critical of child services.

sortorder.description: Position of the service used for sorting. Possible values: 0-999.

propagation_rule.description: Status propagation rule. Must be set together with propagation_value. Possible values: 0 - (default) propagate service status as is - without any changes; 1 - increase the propagated status by a given propagation_value (by 1 to 5 severities); 2 - decrease the propagated status by a given propagation_value (by 1 to 5 severities); 3 - ignore this service - the status is not propagated to the parent service at all; 4 - set fixed service status using a given propagation_value.

propagation_value.description: Status propagation value. Must be set together with propagation_rule. Possible values for propagation_rule with values 0 and 3: 0. Possible values for propagation_rule with values 1 and 2: 1-5. Possible values for propagation_rule with value 4: -1 - OK; 0 - Not classified; 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when service was created.

children.description: Child services to replace the current service children. The children must have the serviceid property defined.

parents.description: Parent services to replace the current service parents. The parents must have the serviceid property defined.

tags.description: Service tags to replace the current service tags.

problem_tags.description: Problem tags to replace the current problem tags.

operator.description: Mapping condition operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) equals; 2 - like.

status_rules.description: Status rules to replace the current status rules.

type.description: Condition for setting (New status) status. Possible values: 0 - if at least (N) child services have (Status) status or above; 1 - if at least (N%) of child services have (Status) status or above; 2 - if less than (N) child services have (Status) status or below; 3 - if less than (N%) of child services have (Status) status or below; 4 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or above is at least (W); 5 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or above is at least (N%); 6 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or below is less than (W); 7 - if weight of child services with (Status) status or below is less than (N%). Where: N (W) is limit_value; (Status) is limit_status; (New status) is new_status.

limit_value.description: Limit value. Possible values: for N and W: 1-100000; for N%: 1-100.

limit_status.description: Limit status. Possible values: -1 - OK; 0 - Not classified; 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster.

new_status.description: New status value. Possible values: 0 - Not classified; 1 - Information; 2 - Warning; 3 - Average; 4 - High; 5 - Disaster.
